item.title: fix(reasoning-tags): prevent internal reflections in replies (#123196)
item.summary: fix(reasoning-tags): prevent internal reflections in replies (#123196) Treat blocks as private reasoning in the shared parser and remove Telegram raw-reasoning fallbacks. This keeps model reflections out of user-visible replies while preserving surrounding answer text. Closes #122623 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi Co-authored-by: WangYan
